children: Gregory Q. Brown, an insider reporting as a Director and serving as Chairman and CEO, reported sales on September 2, 2026. The transactions were sales of Motorola Solutions common stock at weighted average prices of $487.1378, $486.1047, $485.1605 and $483.6769 per share. The total sale amount reported was $6,899,854. Following the reported transactions, Brown directly owned 66,648 shares and indirectly owned 333,670 shares. The reporter undertook to provide upon request full information regarding the number of shares sold at each separate price and noted indirect holdings through the Motorola Solutions 401(k) plan and various trusts.

title: Motorola Solutions Chairman, CEO Sold Shares Worth Over $6.8M
